title: Add an environment discriminator to the channel delivery EventBridge rule before staging or production get mail
description: The delivery rule matches source chatticus.channels and detail type channel.message.created on the account default bus, and all three environments share one account and one default bus. Before staging or production get mail, add an environment field to the event detail and to the rule pattern (or use a per-environment bus) so one environment never invokes another environment's delivery function. Found in the PR 648 review.
